notes.title: 【News】Steam trading card support!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045017/f366f540812696db8e74cfe823646a72e5b74f83.png[/img]We are pleased to announce that the Steam version of "Kubinashi Recollection" now supports Steam Trading Cards!

Please play the game or trade with other users to collect the cards! (8 types in total)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045017/fcf8e9cf16def03b1ae8efab8e66ef3fce81c625.png[/img]
[u][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045017/0a810fdb202533bb0f1ef5d1e02cea50c4ab3483.png[/img]Play the game and get the cards![/u]

Trading cards will be added to your inventory at regular intervals as you play the game.
*The cards that drop are random.

There is a limit to the number of cards you can get through game play.
If you don't have enough cards, try to collect them by exchanging them with other users or buying them!

[u][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045017/0a810fdb202533bb0f1ef5d1e02cea50c4ab3483.png[/img]When you collect all kinds of cards...[/u]

If you collect all the cards, you can exchange them for "badges" that you can use on your Steam profile!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045017/714c68e7190bebff403aafd992f5832a6131de3e.png[/img]
The more cards you collect and the more times you exchange badges, the higher the grade of your badge will be! (up to level 5)
If you collect and exchange all kinds of very rare cards, you can get a special badge...?

notes.title: Update: Screenshot function is now supported.
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "Kubinashi Recollection"!

We've updated the game to support[b] Steam's overlay screenshot (F12)[/b].
Thank you for pointing this out in the community!

We hope this will make the "Kubinashi Recollection" community even more exciting.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.notes:
"Kubinashi Recollection" has been released today!
Please enjoy the cuteness of Sekibanki while "using your head" to solve the action puzzles!

The soundtrack is also available at the same time! If you like the in-game BGM, you'll love this one too!
